metadata.description: Azure region for the workspace, DCE and DCR. Keep these consistent (the DCE/DCR must be in the same region as the workspace).
Tags applied to every created resource that supports tags.
Resource-specific tags, keyed by fully qualified Azure resource type.
Create a new Log Analytics workspace. Set false to target an EXISTING workspace in THIS resource group (provide its name in workspaceName).
Workspace name. When creating: leave empty to auto-generate (abstract-sentinel-<hash>). When using an existing workspace: the exact name of that workspace (must live in this resource group).
Workspace pricing tier. PerGB2018 is the standard pay-as-you-go tier.
Workspace data retention in days. Only applied when creating a new workspace; an existing workspace is never modified. The Abstract table's own retention is customTableRetentionDays.
Enable Microsoft Sentinel on the workspace (only applied when creating a new workspace; assumed already enabled for existing workspaces).

Region of the EXISTING workspace (Existing mode only). The DCE and DCR MUST be created in the same region as the target workspace, so if your existing workspace is in a different region than this deployment, set it here (e.g. eastus2). Leave empty to use the deployment location.
Name of the Data Collection Endpoint (DCE) that receives data from Abstract.
Name of the Data Collection Rule (DCR) that routes data into the workspace table.
Custom log table name. MUST end in _CL. Enter this (as the stream Custom-<table>) in the "Log Stream Name" field of the Abstract destination modal.

Custom table columns. Leave empty (recommended) to use the generated ACS schema: one column per top-level key of the event Abstract sends, with a DCR transformation that sets TimeGenerated. Supply columns only for a custom payload shape; the DCR stream then uses the same columns and transformKql.
DCR transformation used only when tableColumns is supplied. The generated schema carries its own transformation.

Send the Data Collection Rule's ingestion errors (rejected requests, malformed payloads, limit and transformation errors) to the DCRLogErrors table in the workspace. Without it, data Azure refuses or drops is invisible to the customer and to Abstract.

Also write each event into Microsoft's ASIM normalized tables (ASimAuthenticationEventLogs and the others listed in asimSchemas), mapped from the Abstract Common Schema by the Abstract ASIM mappings. Off by default. Microsoft's built-in ASIM parsers read those tables, so once this is on every ASIM analytics rule, hunting query and workbook already running in the workspace also sees Abstract data: expect new alerts, duplicates where Microsoft's own connector collects the same vendor, and a second copy of each mapped event in billing. Turn it on in a staging workspace first, or one schema at a time with asimSchemas. Needs Microsoft Sentinel on the workspace and the generated Abstract schema (tableColumns left empty). Every event still also lands in the Abstract table.
ASIM schemas to write, by name (for example ['Authentication', 'NetworkSession']). ['*'] (default) writes every schema the Abstract ASIM mappings cover; [] writes none.

With enableAsim on, keep each event that an ASIM dataflow takes out of the Abstract table, so it is stored once (in its ASim table) instead of twice. Off by default to keep existing deployments unchanged: content that reads only the Abstract table, such as the Abstract content pack before it reads the ASim tables too, no longer sees those events. Events no ASIM dataflow takes, and everything when enableAsim is off, still land in the Abstract table.

A KQL condition over the Abstract stream selecting events that one of your additionalDataFlows stores. Those events are written by no ASIM dataflow and never go to the lake table, and with excludeAsimFromAbstractTable on they are also kept out of the Abstract table, so each is stored once, in the additionalDataFlows table. It must match exactly what that dataflow takes, or events are lost or stored twice. Empty (default) changes nothing. Set by the Abstract Security for Microsoft Sentinel solution; leave empty when deploying this template on its own.

Name of a second custom table on the Auxiliary (lake-only) plan, for events nothing in Sentinel reads, for example AbstractLake_CL. Empty (default) turns the lake route off. Lake rows cost data lake ingestion and processing (about 0.15 USD per GB at eastus list price against 4.30 in the analytics tier) and are searchable with KQL in the data lake, but analytics rules, ASIM parsers and custom detections do not run on them.

ACS event categories to send to the lake table instead of the Abstract table, for example ['network', 'dns']. An event matches when its event.category contains one of them. Events an ASIM dataflow takes never go to the lake. Empty (default) turns the lake route off.
Total retention of the lake table in days (30 to 4383).

Retention of the Abstract table in days. 0 (default) sends no retention, so an existing table keeps its retention and a new table uses the workspace default. A value shortens or lengthens the table's total retention; shortening deletes data older than the new value.

Table plan for the Abstract table. Keep (default) keeps the plan an existing table already has, and create a new table as Analytics: a redeploy then never changes a table's plan, or its cost, by accident. Analytics runs analytics rules and our content pack on it. Auxiliary is the Sentinel data lake tier: cheap long retention and KQL jobs, but no analytics rules or alerts. Basic sits between them. Setting a plan on an existing table switches it; Azure applies the new plan to the whole table.

Extra tables to create before the Data Collection Rule, for dataflows passed in additionalDataFlows (for example a vendor table such as OktaV2_CL). Each item is {name, columns}, columns in Log Analytics table format. Empty (default) creates none. Used by the Abstract Security for Microsoft Sentinel solution; leave empty when deploying this template on its own.

Extra DCR dataflows on the Abstract stream, each {transformKql, outputStream}. They read the same Custom-<table> stream as the catch-all and do not change what the catch-all keeps. Empty (default) adds none. Azure allows at most 20 dataflows per DCR, counting the catch-all, the ASIM routes and the lake route. Used by the Abstract Security for Microsoft Sentinel solution; leave empty when deploying this template on its own.

Also grant Monitoring Contributor on the DCR. Off by default: sending data through the Logs Ingestion API needs only Monitoring Metrics Publisher, and Monitoring Contributor would let a leaked Abstract credential rewrite or delete the DCR and its error-log setting. Turn on only if your Abstract destination setup specifically asks for it.
Object ID of the service principal Abstract authenticates as (the Enterprise Application object ID, NOT the Application/client ID). Leave empty to skip role assignments and grant them yourself later.
Type of the principal being granted RBAC (avoids PrincipalNotFound on freshly created SPNs).

$fxv#0.description: Generated by gen-sentinel-schema.py from the ACS field catalog (acs-fields.json). One column per top-level ACS key; nested objects and lists are dynamic. The DCR transformation sets TimeGenerated and renames the reserved id and type keys.
$fxv#0.transformKql:
source
| extend TimeGenerated = case(isnotnull(['timestamp']), ['timestamp'], isnotnull(ingested_time), ingested_time, now())
| extend acs_id = tostring(['id']), acs_type = iif(isnotempty(acs_type), acs_type, tostring(['type']))
| project-away ['id'], ['type']

$fxv#1.description: Generated by gen-sentinel-asim.py from the ACS-to-ASIM mappings in solutions/asim. Do not edit by hand.

routes.name: AuditEvent
routes.transformKql:
source
| where tolower(case(isnotempty(acs_type), acs_type, tostring(['type']))) !in ('finding', 'alert')
| extend _category = tolower(tostring(event.category))
| where isnotempty(action) and (_category has 'iam' or _category has 'configuration' or _category has 'audit' or (isempty(_category) and isnotempty(tostring(cloud.provider))))
| extend _action = tolower(tostring(action)), _outcome = tolower(tostring(event.outcome)), _sev = tolower(case(isnotempty(severity), severity, tostring(event.severity)))
| extend _result = case(_outcome in ('success', 'succeeded', 'allowed', 'allow'), 'Success', _outcome in ('failure', 'failed', 'fail', 'denied', 'blocked', 'deny'), 'Failure', _outcome == 'partial', 'Partial', 'NA')
| extend _time = case(isnotnull(['timestamp']), ['timestamp'], isnotnull(ingested_time), ingested_time, now())
| where _time > ago(2d)
| project
    TimeGenerated = _time,
    EventCount = iif(isnull(aggregation_count) or aggregation_count < 1, toint(1), toint(aggregation_count)),
    EventStartTime = case(isnotnull(todatetime(event.start)), todatetime(event.start), isnotnull(aggregation_start), aggregation_start, _time),
    EventEndTime = case(isnotnull(todatetime(event.end)), todatetime(event.end), isnotnull(aggregation_end), aggregation_end, _time),
    EventResult = _result,
    EventOriginalResultDetails = tostring(event.reason),
    EventOriginalType = tostring(action),
    EventOriginalUid = case(isnotempty(tostring(event.id)), tostring(event.id), tostring(['id'])),
    EventSeverity = case(_sev in ('critical', 'high'), 'High', _sev in ('medium', 'warn', 'warning'), 'Medium', _result == 'Failure' or _sev in ('low', 'error'), 'Low', 'Informational'),
    EventOriginalSeverity = case(isnotempty(severity), severity, tostring(event.severity)),
    EventMessage = message,
    EventProduct = product,
    EventVendor = vendor,
    EventSchemaVersion = '0.1.2',
    DvcHostname = host_name,
    DvcIpAddr = case(isnotempty(host_ipv4), host_ipv4, host_ipv6),
    EventType = case(
        _action startswith 'delete' or _action startswith 'remove' or _action startswith 'drop', 'Delete',
        _action startswith 'disable' or _action startswith 'stop' or _action startswith 'deactivate' or _action startswith 'suspend', 'Disable',
        _action startswith 'enable' or _action startswith 'start' or _action startswith 'activate', 'Enable',
        _action startswith 'create' or _action startswith 'add' or _action startswith 'put' or _action startswith 'insert' or _action startswith 'register', 'Create',
        _action startswith 'get' or _action startswith 'list' or _action startswith 'describe' or _action startswith 'read' or _action startswith 'search' or _action startswith 'lookup', 'Read',
        _action startswith 'update' or _action startswith 'modify' or _action startswith 'set' or _action startswith 'change' or _action startswith 'attach' or _action startswith 'detach' or _action startswith 'reset' or _action startswith 'replace', 'Set',
        _action contains 'delet' or _action contains 'remov', 'Delete',
        _action contains 'deactivat' or _action contains 'disabl' or _action contains 'suspend', 'Disable',
        _action contains 'activat' or _action contains 'enabl', 'Enable',
        _action contains 'creat' or _action has 'add', 'Create',
        _action has 'read' or _action has 'list' or _action has 'get' or _action has 'view', 'Read',
        _action contains 'updat' or _action contains 'modif' or _action contains 'chang' or _action has 'reset', 'Set',
        'Other'),
    Operation = tostring(action),
    Object = case(isnotempty(tostring(user.target.name)), tostring(user.target.name), isnotempty(tostring(group.name)), tostring(group.name), gettype(resource) == 'array', tostring(resource[0].name), isnotempty(tostring(resource.name)), tostring(resource.name), isnotempty(tostring(service.target_name)), tostring(service.target_name), isnotempty(tostring(cloud.account_name)), tostring(cloud.account_name), isnotempty(tostring(cloud.account_id)), tostring(cloud.account_id), product),
    ObjectId = case(isnotempty(tostring(user.target.id)), tostring(user.target.id), isnotempty(tostring(group.id)), tostring(group.id), gettype(resource) == 'array', tostring(resource[0].id), tostring(resource.id)),
    ObjectType = case(isnotempty(tostring(user.target.name)) or isnotempty(tostring(group.name)), 'Directory Service Object', isnotempty(tostring(cloud.provider)), 'Cloud Resource', 'Other'),
    OriginalObjectType = case(gettype(resource) == 'array', tostring(resource[0].type), tostring(resource.type)),
    ActorUsername = case(isnotempty(user_name), user_name, user_id),
    ActorUsernameType = case(isempty(user_name), '', user_name has '@', 'UPN', user_name contains '\\', 'Windows', 'Simple'),
    ActorUserId = user_id,
    SrcIpAddr = case(isnotempty(source_ipv4), source_ipv4, isnotempty(source_ipv6), source_ipv6, source_address matches regex '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+$', source_address, ''),
    HttpUserAgent = user_agent,
    TargetAppName = case(isnotempty(tostring(service.target_name)), tostring(service.target_name), isnotempty(tostring(service.name)), tostring(service.name), product),
    AdditionalFields = pack('AbstractEventId', tostring(['id']), 'AbstractCategory', tostring(event.category), 'AbstractDataset', tostring(data_stream.dataset), 'AbstractMatchedRules', matched_rules)
routes.selectionKql:
| extend _sel_AuditEvent_category = tolower(tostring(event.category))
| extend _sel_AuditEvent_action = tolower(tostring(action)), _sel_AuditEvent_outcome = tolower(tostring(event.outcome)), _sel_AuditEvent_sev = tolower(case(isnotempty(severity), severity, tostring(event.severity)))
| extend _sel_AuditEvent_result = case(_sel_AuditEvent_outcome in ('success', 'succeeded', 'allowed', 'allow'), 'Success', _sel_AuditEvent_outcome in ('failure', 'failed', 'fail', 'denied', 'blocked', 'deny'), 'Failure', _sel_AuditEvent_outcome == 'partial', 'Partial', 'NA')
| extend _sel_AuditEvent_time = case(isnotnull(['timestamp']), ['timestamp'], isnotnull(ingested_time), ingested_time, now())
| extend _sel_AuditEvent = (tolower(case(isnotempty(acs_type), acs_type, tostring(['type']))) !in ('finding', 'alert')) and (isnotempty(action) and (_sel_AuditEvent_category has 'iam' or _sel_AuditEvent_category has 'configuration' or _sel_AuditEvent_category has 'audit' or (isempty(_sel_AuditEvent_category) and isnotempty(tostring(cloud.provider))))) and (_sel_AuditEvent_time > ago(2d))

| extend _outcome = tolower(tostring(event.outcome)), _action = tolower(tostring(action)), _sev = tolower(case(isnotempty(severity), severity, tostring(event.severity)))
| extend _result = case(_outcome in ('success', 'succeeded', 'allowed'), 'Success', _outcome in ('failure', 'failed', 'fail', 'denied', 'blocked'), 'Failure', _outcome == 'partial', 'Partial', 'NA')
| extend _time = case(isnotnull(['timestamp']), ['timestamp'], isnotnull(ingested_time), ingested_time, now())

    TimeGenerated = _time,

    EventEndTime = case(isnotnull(todatetime(event.end)), todatetime(event.end), isnotnull(aggregation_end), aggregation_end, _time),
    EventType = iif(_action contains 'logout' or _action contains 'logoff' or _action contains 'signout' or _action contains 'sign_out' or _action contains 'session.end' or _action contains 'session_end', 'Logoff', 'Logon'),
    EventResult = _result,
    EventResultDetails = iif(_result == 'Failure', 'Other', ''),
    EventOriginalResultDetails = tostring(event.reason),
    EventOriginalType = tostring(action),
    EventOriginalUid = case(isnotempty(tostring(event.id)), tostring(event.id), tostring(['id'])),
    EventSeverity = case(_sev in ('critical', 'high'), 'High', _sev in ('medium', 'warn', 'warning'), 'Medium', _result == 'Failure' or _sev in ('low', 'error'), 'Low', 'Informational'),
    EventOriginalSeverity = case(isnotempty(severity), severity, tostring(event.severity)),
    EventMessage = message,
    EventProduct = product,
    EventVendor = vendor,
    EventSchemaVersion = '0.1.4',
    DvcHostname = host_name,
    DvcIpAddr = case(isnotempty(host_ipv4), host_ipv4, host_ipv6),
    TargetUsername = case(isnotempty(user_name), user_name, user_id),
    TargetUsernameType = case(isempty(user_name), 'Simple', user_name has '@', 'UPN', user_name contains '\\', 'Windows', 'Simple'),
    TargetUserId = user_id,
    TargetUserIdType = iif(isnotempty(user_id), 'Other', ''),
    TargetAppName = case(isnotempty(tostring(service.target_name)), tostring(service.target_name), isnotempty(tostring(service.name)), tostring(service.name), product),
    TargetAppId = tostring(service.target_id),
    TargetAppType = 'Other',
    SrcIpAddr = case(isnotempty(source_ipv4), source_ipv4, isnotempty(source_ipv6), source_ipv6, source_address matches regex '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+$', source_address, ''),
    SrcPortNumber = toint(source_port),
    SrcGeoCountry = tostring(source.geo.country_name),
    SrcGeoCity = tostring(source.geo.city_name),
    SrcGeoRegion = tostring(source.geo.region_name),
    HttpUserAgent = user_agent,
    AdditionalFields = pack('AbstractEventId', tostring(['id']), 'AbstractCategory', tostring(event.category), 'AbstractDataset', tostring(data_stream.dataset), 'AbstractMatchedRules', matched_rules)
routes.selectionKql:

| extend _sel_Authentication_time = case(isnotnull(['timestamp']), ['timestamp'], isnotnull(ingested_time), ingested_time, now())

routes.name: Dns
routes.transformKql:
source
| where tolower(case(isnotempty(acs_type), acs_type, tostring(['type']))) !in ('finding', 'alert')
| where isnotempty(tostring(dns.question.name))
| extend _rcode = toupper(tostring(dns.response_code))
| extend _action = tolower(tostring(action)), _outcome = tolower(tostring(event.outcome)), _sev = tolower(case(isnotempty(severity), severity, tostring(event.severity)))
| extend _result = case(_outcome in ('success', 'succeeded', 'allowed', 'allow'), 'Success', _outcome in ('failure', 'failed', 'fail', 'denied', 'blocked', 'deny'), 'Failure', _outcome == 'partial', 'Partial', 'NA')
| extend _time = case(isnotnull(['timestamp']), ['timestamp'], isnotnull(ingested_time), ingested_time, now())
| where _time > ago(2d)
| project
    TimeGenerated = _time,
    EventCount = iif(isnull(aggregation_count) or aggregation_count < 1, toint(1), toint(aggregation_count)),
    EventStartTime = case(isnotnull(todatetime(event.start)), todatetime(event.start), isnotnull(aggregation_start), aggregation_start, _time),
    EventEndTime = case(isnotnull(todatetime(event.end)), todatetime(event.end), isnotnull(aggregation_end), aggregation_end, _time),
    EventResult = case(isempty(_rcode), _result, _rcode == 'NOERROR', 'Success', 'Failure'),
    EventOriginalType = tostring(action),
    EventOriginalUid = case(isnotempty(tostring(event.id)), tostring(event.id), tostring(['id'])),
    EventSeverity = case(_sev in ('critical', 'high'), 'High', _sev in ('medium', 'warn', 'warning'), 'Medium', case(isempty(_rcode), _result, _rcode == 'NOERROR', 'Success', 'Failure') == 'Failure' or _sev in ('low', 'error'), 'Low', 'Informational'),
    EventOriginalSeverity = case(isnotempty(severity), severity, tostring(event.severity)),
    EventMessage = message,
    EventProduct = product,
    EventVendor = vendor,
    EventSchemaVersion = '0.1.7',
    DvcHostname = host_name,
    Dvc = case(isnotempty(host_name), host_name, isnotempty(host_ipv4), host_ipv4, isnotempty(product), product, vendor),
    DvcIpAddr = case(isnotempty(host_ipv4), host_ipv4, host_ipv6),
    EventType = 'Query',
    EventSubType = iif(isnotempty(_rcode) or tolower(tostring(dns.type)) in ('answer', 'response'), 'response', 'request'),
    DnsQuery = tostring(dns.question.name),
    DnsQueryTypeName = toupper(tostring(dns.question.type)),
    DnsQueryClassName = toupper(tostring(dns.question.class)),
    DnsResponseName = _rcode,
    EventResultDetails = _rcode,
    DnsResponseCode = toint(case(_rcode == 'NOERROR', 0, _rcode == 'FORMERR', 1, _rcode == 'SERVFAIL', 2, _rcode == 'NXDOMAIN', 3, _rcode == 'NOTIMP', 4, _rcode == 'REFUSED', 5, tolong(''))),
    TransactionIdHex = tostring(dns.id),
    SrcIpAddr = case(isnotempty(source_ipv4), source_ipv4, isnotempty(source_ipv6), source_ipv6, source_address matches regex '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+$', source_address, ''),
    DstIpAddr = case(isnotempty(dest_ipv4), dest_ipv4, isnotempty(dest_ipv6), dest_ipv6, dest_address matches regex '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+$', dest_address, ''),
    SrcPortNumber = toint(source_port),
    Src = case(isnotempty(source_ipv4), source_ipv4, isnotempty(source_ipv6), source_ipv6, isnotempty(tostring(source.domain)), tostring(source.domain), host_name),
    DstPortNumber = toint(dest_port),
    NetworkProtocol = toupper(tostring(network.transport)),
    SrcUsername = user_name,
    DvcAction = case(_action in ('allow', 'allowed', 'accept', 'accepted', 'permit', 'pass') or _outcome in ('allow', 'allowed'), 'Allow', _action in ('deny', 'denied', 'block', 'blocked', 'reject', 'rejected') or _outcome in ('deny', 'denied', 'blocked'), 'Deny', _action in ('drop', 'dropped'), 'Drop', ''),
    AdditionalFields = pack('AbstractEventId', tostring(['id']), 'AbstractCategory', tostring(event.category), 'AbstractDataset', tostring(data_stream.dataset), 'AbstractMatchedRules', matched_rules)
routes.selectionKql:
| extend _sel_Dns_rcode = toupper(tostring(dns.response_code))
| extend _sel_Dns_action = tolower(tostring(action)), _sel_Dns_outcome = tolower(tostring(event.outcome)), _sel_Dns_sev = tolower(case(isnotempty(severity), severity, tostring(event.severity)))
| extend _sel_Dns_result = case(_sel_Dns_outcome in ('success', 'succeeded', 'allowed', 'allow'), 'Success', _sel_Dns_outcome in ('failure', 'failed', 'fail', 'denied', 'blocked', 'deny'), 'Failure', _sel_Dns_outcome == 'partial', 'Partial', 'NA')
| extend _sel_Dns_time = case(isnotnull(['timestamp']), ['timestamp'], isnotnull(ingested_time), ingested_time, now())
| extend _sel_Dns = (tolower(case(isnotempty(acs_type), acs_type, tostring(['type']))) !in ('finding', 'alert')) and (isnotempty(tostring(dns.question.name))) and (_sel_Dns_time > ago(2d))
